meta.name: Transsion/XOS Secret Codes
meta.source: Reverse-engineered from Factory.apk + EngineerMode.apk (X6525, XOS Android 13) and field-verified
meta.access_chain: LOCK SCREEN: Emergency call -> dial code directly. OOBE/FRP: WiFi -> privacy link -> Chrome -> tel: link -> dialer -> dial code

codes.detail: Sets persist.sys.usb.config=adb; survives reboot and setup state. The key unlock code.
Full Unisoc engineering mode: hardware tests, AT commands, NV access UI.

notes: *#*#49#*#* works from the emergency dialer ON THE LOCK SCREEN - no unlock needed (Transsion receiver has no keyguard check)
Direct broadcast of SECRET_CODE from shell is denied - must use the real dialer.
Codes are host strings in the manifest; the receiver may dispatch additional codes dynamically.
